en: Like, I'd only talk to a girl who was clearly mad at being stood up. Or who looked like she wasn't keen on the plans she had made.
Yeah, I guess in that sorta situation it could be fun to go off with ya, Akiyama-san, but...
I'd just have to know. Why is she upset, why is she anxious? Those are things I'd worry about later on, so it's nice to be able to hear it from the person herself.
Someone's got a lotta free time on his hands! But I guess that's very like you.
Call it a personal failing of mine.
Nothin' that really qualifies as a hobby.
Okay, what would you like to do most right now?
Right now? Right now I really wanna sleep!
Heh. Why's that?
I haven't been sleepin' at all lately, so I'm super tired!
Have you been busy? You need to make sure you get enough rest or you'll wreck your health.
Exams are done, but I'm still always comin' to work, and then when I get home I gotta do job huntin' paperwork, so every day's an ordeal.
I see. Well, try not to overdo it.
Thanks for bein' concerned about me.
I'm curious about what your thoughts are on romance, Honoka-chan. Mind if I ask you some things?
What sorta things did ya have in mind?
What would your ideal date be?
A trip to an amusement park! Oh, except goin' with a guy would be a pain, so on second thought, maybe not.
What do you mean? Why's going with a guy a pain?
Guys are always yammerin' on about what rides to go on next. I prefer to take a seat on a bench and drink in the atmosphere for a bit.
I see. I suppose us men are fans of roller coasters and other thrill rides. Sitting on a Ferris wheel just looking at stuff is boring.
See? It'd be better if I went with a girl.
Have you ever been disillusioned with a man?
I sure have! Especially with guys who are nothin' but talk!
Like, they start off talkin' the talk and all, but if ya dig a little deeper, you find out they can't walk the walk.
So guys who just front with the ladies, then.
Yeah! All they do is brag, and then get pissy when ya catch 'em in a lie. Why can't they just be up front about things?
Maybe they just want to have a good time having drinks with someone at a cabaret club.
I'm fine if it's a guy who's a customer, but I sure couldn't date a guy like that.
How many men have you dated?
Huh? Lemme think about that for a sec...
Wow, has it been that many?
Ya wanna know about men only? Or should I be countin' girls, too?
Sure. Guys and girls.
Hmm... I've dated a lotta folks at the same time, so it's hard to come up with a number.
Yeesh, you really play around, don't you?
That ain't it! I just feel bad about turnin' someone down when they say they like me, so I go do karaoke or stuff with 'em a few times, just to be nice.
But a lotta guys have done that with me, so I can't say I "dated" all of 'em. And sometimes I reject a bunch of 'em all at once, too.
I guess a lot of people think you're dating material.
I've dated girls before. Things didn't last all that long, but it was pretty fun!
So not just hanging out with lady friends, then?
Yeah. Like I've gone as far as kissin' at least!
Yeah, I suppose that isn't too unusual. Women can bond that way easily enough, right?
Yeah. But goin' beyond that's a bit, well...
I guess if things had gone on longer they might have gone beyond that indeed.
Honoka-chan, can I ask you about yourself?
About me? Sure, ask me whatever ya want!
What do you consider your strengths to be?
My strengths? I guess I'm always smilin'. A lotta folks tell me my smile's so natural, that I don't gotta fake it for work or nothin'.
Yeah, when I see you smile, it has an infectious quality that makes me feel better.
But it kinda sucks because when I'm mad, people think I'm still smilin'.
It really gets my goat when I'm ticked off and no one seems to take me seriously.
Guess a smiling face has its ups and downs, huh?
What do you consider your shortcomings to be?
I guess I'm kinda impatient. I'm always in a rush to get stuff done, and I get all fidgety and stuff.
You must get annoyed by it sometimes when you're here spendin' time with me.
Well, to be honest, I can't say that's never been the case.
I figured. I know it ain't one of my better traits, so I've been thinkin' I oughta fix that about myself.
Fixing personality problems isn't easy. It might be quicker if I just get used to it.
Oh? Ya don't mind me the way I am?
Everyone's got their flaws. Being able to get along with someone in spite of them is how real bonds are forged.
You're so sweet, Akiyama-san! I like being able to be myself and relax around ya!
If you could rein it in a bit, though, that might not be such a bad thing.
I don't. I'd speak up if that were the case.
Come on, do I strike you as the lying sort?
Ya do, actually. That's why I'm askin'.
I trust folks who are straight shooters more than those who don't speak their mind.
Got it. I'll keep that in mind.
What's your favorite part of your body?
I'm real proud of my hair!
I mean, it's just so sheer and silky! I could probably be in a shampoo commercial!
Wow. I kind of want to feel it now.
It's all styled up with hair gel, so I dunno if touchin' it now would give ya the right idea.
People who get to touch my real hair are only those I spend my personal time with.
Man, now I'm jealous.
You know, I've been wondering something.
Huh? Usually I just wear a T-shirt.
I toss and turn a lot in my sleep, so sometimes when I wake up my shirt's come off!
One time, I heard the doorbell ring and, just as I was about to open the door, I freaked out 'cause I realized I had no shirt on!
Hehe, that must wake you up real quick.
Where do you hate to be touched?
Oh, I hate bein' touched around my neck!
Like right at the nape?
Yeah! I'm super sensitive there!
I get all wigged out if I'm on a packed train and some old dude's breathin' down my neck!
Yeah, that does sound pretty unpleasant.
It's gotten to the point where I wanna get a scarf just to cover my neck.
Your neck is lovely, so that's a shame.
Y'know, I actually got measured just a little while ago. Lemme try and remember.
I think they were 78, 56, 82?
You're in great shape. Aren't those numbers pretty ideal?
For real? I ain't too skinny?
No, I think you're just right.
Yeah? It's hard for me to put meat on my bones, so that's a relief to hear!
I'm jealous. Lately, I get all self-conscious about my belly after eating and drinking.
You're skinny! You have the physique of a model.
Hey, I'm self-conscious about how skinny I am, so don't say that sorta thing! My body doesn't put on weight even if I eat.
Really? I was trying to compliment you.
Guys all like a girl with big boobs, so bein' a scrawny little thing don't help me at all.
Not all guys are into huge breasts. Many of us prefer slender women.
For real? Ain't that just a Lolita complex?
I wouldn't go <Italic>that</Italic> far.
Akiyama-san, welcome! I'm super happy that ya decided to request me!
Did ya come to see me? I gotta wonder if ya might be fallin' for me!
I've been waitin' for ya, Akiyama-san! Today's gonna be a lotta fun!
Nice to meet you. My name's Honoka!
Here, this is my business card. <Color:255,200,200,255>⑮<Color:Default>
And what's your name, sir?
Shun Akiyama.
It's a pleasure to meet ya, Akiyama-san!
Likewise.
Thanks again for comin'!
Just for you, Akiyama-san!
You smell nice, Akiyama-san. Ya wearin' cologne?
Someone's lookin' good! I like how that outfit looks on ya! <Color:255,200,200,255>⑮<Color:Default>
You're lookin' nice today! <Color:255,200,200,255>⑮<Color:Default>
Wearin' the usual again, Akiyama-san?
Sorry, but that getup ain't so hot.
Ah, no way! I think I'd straight-up kill myself if I had to wear that.
For real!? You're so generous, Akiyama-san!
Oh? Really?
Gonna try yer luck, huh?
All right. We'll keep your bottle for ya, Akiyama-san.
All right. A house bottle it is.
I'd like you to bring me my bottle.
Mind if I have some?
Oh, sorry.
Your glass is empty. Whaddya want next?
Mind if I have a glass, too?
Much obliged!
Ooh, ya like that? <Color:255,200,200,255>⑮<Color:Default>
Ya actually like that? You and me got different tastes.
If ya want somethin', just speak up.
Hey, wanna play the chocolate stick game?
Sure, that sounds fun.
Here, lemme feed it to ya! <Color:255,200,200,255>⑮<Color:Default>
Lemme get that for ya.
Lemme refill your glass for ya.
Cheeeers!
I have to be going.
Why don't ya kill time somewhere? I'll give ya a call later.
All right. Let me get ya your bill.
Your glass is empty. What do ya want next?
(Oops, I don't have the money.)
I should actually get going.
Mind if I have another glass?
(Guess I've run out of stuff to talk about. I should be on my way.)
I have to get going.
Want to go out after this?
I already told ya no. Yeesh, you're persistent.
Nuh-uh! Ya can ask all ya want, but no means no!
No go, huh?
After this?
Oh, I've already got other plans today. But ask me again next time.
That's too bad. But I understand.
Today really ain't so great. I'm not really in the mood.
Okay. Some other time, if you feel like it.
Maybe after I get to know ya a bit better!
Geez, you're persistent! But I guess it'd be okay to go out for a little bit. Better than havin' ya pesterin' me all night.
Oh, great.
Ya wanna go out with me that bad, huh? Okay, I can spare a little time.
Sure, I've been wantin' to spend more time with ya myself, Akiyama-san!
Sure I would! I'd never say no to goin' on a date with you, Akiyama-san!
Why not? I got some free time!
Ooh, I really like this! But I bet ya knew that already, didn't ya, Akiyama-san?
Whoa, for real!? I've been wantin' this! Thank you!
Are ya sure? I'll take good care of this!
The heck is this!? I dunno what to do with it.
You already gave me this. Did ya forget?
I hope you'll come by again, Akiyama-san.
Next time I'll put in a request for you.
For real? Then I'll be waitin'!
Thanks for comin' today! See ya later!
You too.
Today was really fun!
Ya come back soon now!
See ya later, okay? <Color:255,200,200,255>⑮<Color:Default>
Wonder what you'll get?
Fingers crossed.
That one pops out a lot. I'm wonderin' if it's even worth what ya paid.
Don't say that. You're making me sad...
Hey, that ain't too bad! Ya kinda got yer money's worth on that one.
This isn't about the money, you know.
Amazin'! That's super rare! Can ya get me one too?
Really? Then I guess I shouldn't give it away.
That's incredible! Ya hit the jackpot! Makes sense a man like you would have good luck. <Color:255,200,200,255>⑮<Color:Default>
Heh, not bad.
Time to do the chocolate stick game!
Hello. Welcome to Club Eden.
I'll find you a hostess, then. This way, sir.
You'd like to see Shion-san? This way, sir.
I'm terribly sorry, sir, but Shion-san isn't here at the moment, I'm afraid.
Oh, okay. I'll come back later.
(Did I have anything interesting to talk about? Oh, wait, there was that one thing! Yeah! Wait, no, I can't talk about <Italic>that</Italic>.)
(There's a lot I want to ask, but I don't want her to think I'm using her as a source. Okay, today I need to forget about work and blow off some steam!)
(I can't afford to order stuff at a classy club like this! But I don't want to look cheap. Sheesh, why do I have to be hungry right now!?)
(Would she be happy if I gave her a present out of the blue? If she likes me more, then it might lead to something!)
(Maybe the mood's right to ask her on a date after this. But what if she says no? That'd be a huge buzzkill. Ah, I don't know what to do!)
(Crap, did I have a deadline for that copy? Maybe I should be heading home.)
What are your plans for New Year's, Shinada-san?
Nothing special. I guess the usual for me, which is either running around crazy busy or sleeping at home. What about you, Shion-chan?
My grandmother is coming to visit. I haven't seen her in a long time, so I'm really looking forward to it!
Sounds nice. I wish I could spend the holidays like that.
But we don't do this every year. My grandmother doesn't come see us very often.
Isn't that backwards? Aren't the kids and grandkids supposed to go visit the grandparents?
Typically yes, but my grandmother was quite insistent about coming to Japan this year.
My grandmother lives in Lyon, France. So regardless of who visits whom, it's always something of an undertaking.
Must be expensive. If your whole family has to go to France, traveling every year would be pretty rough, huh?
